localBiteReport: Reports from late October through early November 2026 show Choctawhatchee Bay in solid fall fishing shape. Redfish remain the most dependable inshore target, with fish actively feeding around Destin's bridges, passes, and grass-flat guts and potholes throughout the bay — post-hurricane water clarity recovered to tannin-stained but fishable conditions. Quality speckled trout in the 22–27-inch range are also being found near concentrations of baitfish, with live bait the top producer and artificials in deeper water expected to pick up as temperatures cool further. November is shaping up as a strong month for flounder, sheepshead, and black drum as well, with pelagics largely moving out and inshore structure bite taking center stage. Water temperature at this location is 74°F. Note: the most recent available written report is from the Oct 30–Nov 5 week; a Half Hitch Destin report dated Nov 2 is confirmed posted but its full content was not accessible for this summary.
